licensee

  • CURIE: gmeow:licensee
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/licensee
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/rights
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The party receiving a licence (odrl:assignee). A specialisation of gmeow:hasParty. Absent on an open / public licence offered to everyone.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:License -> gmeow:Agent Sub-property of: gmeow:hasParty

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:licensee from gmeow:License to gmeow:Agent when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasParty, gmeow:License, gmeow:Agent

External Equivalences

Equivalent or closely aligned targets: odrl

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to name the party receiving a licence (the odrl:assignee) when a grant is to a specific agent — the licence-scoped specialisation of gmeow:hasParty.

Avoid when

  • Avoid setting it for an open public licence offered to everyone (leave it absent) and avoid minting a separate receiving-party model; this specialises gmeow:hasParty.

How to use

  • Add one or more gmeow:licensee agents to a License (non-functional) for a party-specific grant; omit it for a public CC/open-source offer that anyone may accept.

Examples

  • ex:enterpriseLicense gmeow:licensee ex:acmeCorp.
